scope: All existing relations in eight pathway systems plus targeted drug-target mappings and the generated pharmacology overlay. Not a complete re-audit of all 88 compound dossiers or every regulatory claim.

coverage.access: Fresh primary abstract; source record saved.
coverage.assessment: Cat basal forebrain microdialysis; association direction and regional limitation match the primary record.
Engineered human A2A–adenosine structure is active-intermediate. Structural/context classification correctly avoids a functional inference.

coverage.access: Fresh primary abstract and PMC full text.
coverage.assessment: Kull supports rat striatal Gₒₗf activation; Carpenter supports engineered human mini-Gₛ association. Separate the combined node as AG-04.
Mouse Gnal loss abolishes adenosine-stimulated AC in caudate putamen; no VLPO/sleep endpoint is claimed.
Rat Type-2, not all VLPO neurons: postsynaptic A2A excitation. These cells are serotonin-excited; Type-1 cells differ.
Adora2a-Cre identifies the manipulated mouse population; the edge correctly does not claim direct receptor activation.
ChR2-labelled NAc-core cells project densely to VP; anatomy edge does not imply excitation.
Terminal stimulation inhibits VP firing and produces picrotoxin-sensitive IPSCs; postsynaptic molecular subtype unresolved.
VP terminal stimulation increases SWS. VP lesion necessity can be added without equating it with a unique cellular mechanism.
Caffeine-induced waking is lost in A2A-knockout, not A1-knockout mice; this does not mean caffeine lacks A1 antagonism.
Mouse conditional deletion and rat RNAi implicate shell A2A receptors; correct separation from core cell manipulation.
Loss of shell receptor signaling attenuates/prevents caffeine waking. Context sign correctly avoids saying A2A activation promotes wake.

coverage.access: Fresh PMC full text and Methods.
coverage.assessment: Human α1β2γ2 GABA binding plus independent GABA-evoked currents support agonism. Bound cryo-EM structures are desensitized/nonconducting, not proof of an open channel.

coverage.access: Fresh PMC full text; electrophysiology at −75 mV, 150 mM CsCl internal.
coverage.assessment: Ligand-gated anion current is correct. Voltage clamp used a high-chloride internal solution; neither physiological chloride influx nor universal hyperpolarization follows. Retain current ionic-gradient limitation.
Human α1β2γ2 electrophysiology supports PAM; structural allosteric sites are distinct from GABA sites. The edge does not claim orthosteric agonism.
Mouse POA axon stimulation suppresses orexin firing and is bicuculline-sensitive. Native receptor subunit assembly was not established.
TMN projection defines a POA GABA subset. The explicit warning that broader POA GABA stimulation can promote waking is supported.

coverage.access: Fresh PMC full text and figure legend.
coverage.assessment: Chung Extended Data Fig. 2 shows terminal-evoked IPSCs in HDC-confirmed TMN cells, blocked by bicuculline; inhibition is functional, not just anatomical.
Bidirectional manipulation of projection-defined cells changes sleep; soma stimulation and collaterals prevent exclusive TMN attribution.

coverage.access: Fresh PMC3002444 full text via web.
coverage.assessment: Rat H1/H2-mediated excitation and increased GABA input are supported. Source of the GABA input is not directly mapped; caveat retained.

coverage.access: Fresh PMC3002444 full text via web.
coverage.assessment: Histamine inhibition of NA-inhibited rat cells is gabazine/TTX-sensitive; putative sleep classification remains appropriately limited.
Male mouse projection-defined VLPO GABA neurons are inhibited by NA/5HT. In-vivo sleep consequence and identity with rat physiological classes are unproven.

coverage.access: Original abstract plus publisher-indexed original methods/PDF
coverage.assessment: Activation denotes receptor agonism, not increased cAMP. The recombinant-cell boundary is preserved.
Binding and function are distinct assays; the current limitation makes this distinction.

coverage.access: Original abstract plus publisher-indexed original methods/PDF
coverage.assessment: Inhibitory direction correct; PTX-sensitive family assignment does not identify a particular native SCN Gα isoform.
Correct inhibitory direction; no untested complete SCN signaling chain is inferred.
Acute firing suppression is distinguished from circadian phase and whole-animal sleep duration.

coverage.access: Original abstract and publisher-indexed full-text Results/Figure 6
coverage.assessment: MT2-associated activation is supported pharmacologically. Name antagonist selectivities and CT10 separately; not subtype-specific genetic proof.

coverage.access: Fresh original Hunt and McArthur abstracts; Hunt publisher Results
coverage.assessment: McArthur provides manipulation evidence beyond correlation. Circadian phase advance is not immediate hypnotic action; no unmeasured PLC intermediary is inserted.
Context sign is correct; separate in-vivo dose from slice concentration. No universal MT1-versus-MT2 functional division.

coverage.access: Original abstract and publisher/PMC-indexed original Results
coverage.assessment: Context edge correct. This anatomy was not demonstrated as a melatonin-driven serial pathway in the same experiment.

coverage.access: Original abstract and PMC-indexed original Results
coverage.assessment: Context edge and apposition limit are appropriate; do not convert markers/apposition into verified excitatory functional synapses.

coverage.access: Original abstract and PMC-indexed original Results
coverage.assessment: Context sign accurately limits the evidence to anatomy and transmitter phenotype, not a measured melatonin sleep effect.

coverage.access: Fresh primary full text/XML including construct details
coverage.assessment: Structural interface supported; do not use it to claim exclusive native Gq coupling or signal kinetics.

coverage.access: Fresh original abstract and publisher-indexed experimental snippet; full Methods not retrievable this round
coverage.assessment: Constitutive activity and species/cell scope supported. Keep conservative IPs wording; the detailed total-radiolabel separation protocol was not independently re-read this round. No basis to replace it with a time-resolved IP3-specific claim.
Agonist direction correct; functional expression does not restrict receptor distribution to histamine neurons.
Inhibitory direction correct; cell cAMP is kept separate from transmitter-release measurements.

coverage.access: Fresh original abstract and visual inspection of publisher Figure 3
coverage.assessment: Inhibitory autoreceptor branch supported. Ligand-driven and constitutive activity are correctly distinguished; this does not exhaust H3 heteroreceptor actions.

coverage.access: Fresh original PMC Methods and Results
coverage.assessment: Context sign appropriate: functional dependence is not receptor localization to each cholinergic cell. Evidence concerns BF, not an H1 localization claim in TMN.

coverage.access: Fresh original PMC Methods and Results
coverage.assessment: Direction and local dependence supported; no claim that BF cholinergic neurons are the sole normal wake mechanism.

coverage.access: Fresh original abstract; no complete electrophysiology Methods access this round
coverage.assessment: Pharmacology supports OX2 involvement; expression/potency does not prove OX1 absence. Current qualified subtype wording should remain.

coverage.access: Fresh Yamanaka abstract; Carter original full-text Results/Discussion
coverage.assessment: Excitatory connection supported; current necessity limitation overreaches from histamine synthesis to an entire neuronal projection. Apply finding ox2-tmn-hist.
Metabolic role supported. Do not convert chronic genetic perturbation into a clinical inhibitor safety/efficacy conclusion.

coverage.access: Fresh original full text/XML and EEG/EMG Results
coverage.assessment: Context sign and text correctly avoid assigning a normal-metabolism sign. Separating this endpoint from BF cortical activation improves graph fidelity.
Rat DAT, COS7 expression and sodium-dependent dopamine uptake are explicitly reported.
Human NET in HeLa with sodium-dependent uptake is explicitly reported.
DAT dopamine-uptake IC50 is 6390 nM (rounded to 6.4 micromolar); this is functional uptake, not a binding Ki or causal human wake endpoint.
NET norepinephrine-uptake IC50 is 35.6 micromolar; the dopamine substrate condition is different. Current figure correctly uses norepinephrine and does not establish human NET necessity.
Ten healthy men, 200/400 mg, cocaine/raclopride PET. Current wording correctly distinguishes DAT occupancy and inferred extracellular dopamine from wake causation.
DAT knockout abolished the usual drug wake response but also changed baseline sleep. Current context sign and developmental limitation are appropriate. No direct NET causal chain follows.
Drd2 knockout attenuated GBR12909 arousal; naming GBR12909 improves specificity. D2 only, no D3/D4 implication.
Photostimulation supports sufficiency under tested patterns; sustained high frequency can produce arrests. It is not evidence that permanent LC loss eliminates all wake.
Confirmed timing/laterality condition missing; endpoint is loss of Hcrt-induced latency shortening, not cessation of spontaneous awakening.
GABAB1/2 heteromeric assembly and agonist-responsive Kir3 function are supported; individual subunits alone couple poorly.
HEK293/Xenopus Kir3 functional coupling is supported; this does not establish currents in a human sleep nucleus.
PTX-sensitive baclofen inhibition is supported; a particular G-alpha subtype was not resolved.
Predominantly N-type channel currents were recorded with Ba2+ carrier. No direct presynaptic-release measurement.
Baclofen hyperpolarization and loss after orexin-cell Gabbr1 deletion are supported; corrected panel order independently checked.
Fragmentation without a change in accumulated state times is supported; no direct proof that GABAB agonism increases sleep.
5 mM EC50 and 69% maximum versus L-baclofen support assay-specific partial agonism. No human exposure-response or clinical mechanism is established.
GHB/analog hub binding and thermal stabilization are supported; 5-HDC supplied the structure. Basal enzyme assays showed no inhibition; no clinical narcolepsy mechanism was proven.
Dopamine was assayed separately at both D1 and D5; family summary is supported.
D1 and D5 complexes were both resolved with dominant-negative Gs; structural classification is correct.
Both D1 and D5 had individual GloSensor cAMP accumulation assays.
All three structures exist; D4 used a Gi/Gs chimeric G-alpha, which should be stated.
Each D2/D3/D4 subtype was assayed in inhibition mode after 100 nM isoproterenol; no subtype borrowing.
D2-only knockout reduced and fragmented wake, particularly early dark phase. Current context and no-D3/D4 limitation are sound.
Acute NREM transition and repeated wake-maintenance results are supported; acute REM negative result is missing.
CGS21680 lowered D2 agonist affinity in rat striatal membranes without demonstrating a physical heteromer or a sleep phenotype. Correct context sign and D2-only node.
344-patient, 12-week trial supports IRLS/CGI-I improvement. It does not localize receptor/circuit action or establish long-term guidance.
Recombinant OX1 receptor peptide pharmacology; not equivalent peptide potency.
Separated recombinant agonism from the distinct structural observation.
CHO OX1R calcium influx and driving-force dependence; not assumed store-operated calcium entry.
IP3 was measured in the CHO system; no universal neuronal one-way Gq cascade inferred.
Calcium entry enhances PLC response to low orexin-A concentrations in this assay.

coverage.assessment: Rat OX2R-EGFP in BIM human-rat hybrid cells; PTX-insensitive fura-2 response.

Engineered mini-G structural complex is not a native coupling-efficiency assay.
Rat ex-vivo postsynaptic depolarization and OX1 antagonist pharmacology; no tonic activation inferred.

LC manipulation identifies the experimental cell population and context, not a new causal pathway.
Regional AAV-Cre rescue includes TMN and adjacent posterior hypothalamus.
Wake consolidation improved but sleep fragmentation persisted; no TMN-cell-specific attribution.
Rat histamine neuron excitation; the study does not establish universal projection necessity.
Bounded addition; observation and interpretation limits retained.

findings.problem: 7 个药物的证据粒度不足以统一映射到人 α1β2γ2 受体档案。
findings.current: cinolazepam / delorazepam / pinazepam / ketazolam / nordazepam / oxazolam / clobazam: assays[0].target = gaba.
findings.correctionZh: 以上 7 项应使用 gabaa-family。clobazam 的范围来自 α1/α2/α3/α5β2γ2S 四种组合；nordazepam 为大鼠组织结合；其余本条证据为标签或类别药理。保留 fludiazepam 的已核实人 α1β2γ2 数据，以及既有 diazepam / zolpidem / eszopiclone / zaleplon 数据。
findings.correctionEn: Use gabaa-family for these seven records. The clobazam range pools four α-subunit assemblies; nordazepam uses rat tissue binding, and the other cited entries are label/class evidence. Preserve independently verified subtype-specific records.

verification.primaryChecks: Fresh Hammer 2015 full text: human α1/2/3/5β2γ2S, Xenopus TEVC. Fresh Gobbi 1987 abstract: rat cortex/cerebellum/adrenal tissue. BASG and PMDA labels and AEMPS comparator checked; local assay scopes explicitly lack subtype resolution. AIFA endpoints were attempted but could not be independently retrieved this turn; no AIFA-specific quantitative claim is made.
verification.preserve: Norman 2026 PMID 41946818 independently confirms human α1β2γ2 functional assays; fludiazepam is not included in this correction.

findings.problem: 通用关键词分类混淆结合增强、功能正向变构调节、直接激活及原药/代谢物。
findings.current: atlasAction classifies generic potentiation or 增强 as PAM; drug→target overlay starts from the parent drug even when the assay tested trichloroethanol.
findings.correctionZh: 按经审核的 assay 作用类型分类。oxazepam 本条保留“增强 GABA 结合”；pentobarbital 保留“增强 GABA 电流；较高浓度直接激活”；chloral hydrate / triclofos 标明经活性代谢物三氯乙醇，或新增代谢物节点。midazolam 的原论文明确研究正向变构调节，可标为 PAM，但不应仅靠“增强”一词判定。
findings.correctionEn: Use reviewed assay action types. Preserve GABA-binding enhancement for the cited oxazepam assay; show both potentiation and direct activation for pentobarbital; represent trichloroethanol as the tested active metabolite for chloral hydrate and triclofos. Midazolam PAM is supported by its primary study, independently of the generic keyword.

verification.access: Fresh primary abstracts via PubMed / Europe PMC on 2026-11-06.
verification.pentobarbital: Cultured rat hippocampal neurons: potentiation EC50 94 μM with 1 μM GABA; direct activation EC50 0.33 mM. Higher concentrations also block channels; one PAM label does not describe the complete concentration-dependent action.
verification.metabolite: PMID 7834208 directly tested trichloroethanol in mouse neurons. PMID 9495852 directly tested trichloroethanol at recombinant α2β1 and other receptors. Neither experiment demonstrates direct parent-drug receptor action.
verification.midazolam: PMID 35285894 explicitly investigates positive allosteric modulation of GABAA-mediated miniature IPSCs; its PAM assignment is not itself a scientific error.

findings.problem: 手工结构边已正确限定，但药物叠加图仍可从 2YDO 记录生成激动箭头。
findings.current: data.js adenosine→a2a activity: agonist; method Structural and functional study; source PDB 2YDO. Molecular overlay excludes the curated structural edge then synthesizes an activation edge.
findings.correctionZh: 腺苷是 A₂A 激动剂这一药理结论不需否定，但 2YDO 结构记录应明确为正构结合证据。功能激动边必须单独绑定匹配配体和实验体系的功能来源，不能由 PDB 条目或“激动剂结合态”自动推导。
findings.correctionEn: Adenosine agonism is not in dispute. Treat the 2YDO entry as orthosteric binding evidence, and attach a separate ligand- and system-matched functional source to any agonism edge; a ligand-bound structure alone is insufficient.

verification.access: Fresh Lebon 2011 full text and latest overlay implementation.
verification.finding: The reported structures are active-intermediate. The GL31 functional paragraph refers to CGS21680 stimulation; the adenosine pose itself does not measure signaling. The curated ad-ligand-receptor edge is already correct and should remain structural.

findings.problem: 同一效应分子节点合并天然 Gₒₗf 与工程化 mini-Gₛ，视觉上仍可能串成 mini-Gₛ→AC 的功能链。
findings.current: Node Gₒₗf / mini-Gₛ receives an activation edge and connects to an AC/cAMP activation edge, although the detailed caveat separates the evidence.
findings.correctionZh: 把 Gₒₗf 功能耦联与 mini-Gₛ 结构结合拆成两个节点/两条边。只保留 Gₒₗf→AC 功能线；mini-Gₛ 仅进入 structural 层。当前详细文字并非事实错误，属于应优先改善的图形语义。
findings.correctionEn: Split functional Gₒₗf coupling from structural mini-Gₛ association. Retain the AC edge from Gₒₗf only; place mini-Gₛ in the structural layer. The present caveat is accurate, but the combined node can imply an unsupported functional chain.

verification.access: Fresh Kull/Corvol primary abstracts and Carpenter full text.
verification.finding: Native striatal Gₒₗf activation and Gnal loss support the functional branch; mini-Gₛ is an engineered structural partner.

findings.problem: VP 末梢刺激的因果表述已谨慎，但可补充论文实际做过的 VP 损毁实验。
findings.current: The limitation states that the terminal experiment does not independently establish VP inhibition as the sole or necessary mediator.
findings.correctionZh: 补充 VP 损毁使末梢刺激诱导的慢波睡眠增加消失；同时保留限制：这支持完整 VP 的必要性，未证明某一 VP 分子亚群的抑制是唯一机制。
findings.correctionEn: Add that VP lesions abolished terminal-stimulation-induced SWS. This supports a requirement for intact VP, without proving that inhibition of one molecular VP subtype is the sole mechanism.

verification.access: Fresh Oishi 2017 full text, Results and VP lesion experiment.
verification.finding: The lesion experiment is positive necessity evidence for VP integrity, distinct from cell-subtype-specific mediation.

findings.problem: 同一 VLPO 节点承接两种不同物种与鉴定方式的细胞证据，容易暗示完全相同细胞群。
findings.current: Rat NA-inhibited putative sleep cells (Liu 2010) and mouse projection-defined VLPO GABA cells (Saito 2018) share the vlpo-sleep node.
findings.correctionZh: 保留共同 VLPO 节点时，补充“各研究分别定义细胞群，未证明两类细胞完全重合”。更严格的图谱可拆分两个节点。不要把这些细胞与 Gallopin 的 serotonin-excited Type-2 细胞直接等同。
findings.correctionEn: If retaining a common VLPO node, state that the populations were defined independently and were not shown to coincide. They must not be equated with the serotonin-excited Type-2 cells of Gallopin 2005.

verification.access: Fresh Liu 2010 and Saito 2018 full text; Gallopin primary abstract.
verification.finding: The shared node is a visual abstraction, not demonstrated cellular identity; this is a precision improvement rather than a reversed edge.

findings.problem: Hdc 缺失被扩大解释为整个 OX2R→TMN 支路非必需，混淆了递质合成缺失与神经元/投射消除。系统 designNotes 重复此表述。

limitation.zh: 该支路不是全部食欲素觉醒效应的必经通路。
limitation.en: This branch is not obligatory for every orexin arousal effect.

designNotes.zh: 食欲素至 TMN 的连接是一条有实验证据的支路，并非所有食欲素促觉醒效应的必经通路。H₁R–Gq 复合物结构与 H₁R 构成性活性相关的肌醇磷酸（IPs）累积属于不同实验；后者不是 IP₃ 特异性测定。
designNotes.en: The orexin-to-TMN connection is experimentally supported but is not obligatory for every orexin-mediated arousal effect. The H₁R–Gq complex structure and inositol-phosphate (IPs) accumulation associated with H₁R constitutive activity are separate experiments; the latter is not an IP₃-specific assay.

findings.correctionZh: 在 Hdc 缺失小鼠中，食欲素神经元光刺激仍可缩短睡眠至觉醒的转换潜伏期，说明组胺合成对这一实验条件下的快速唤醒并非必需。该实验没有消除 TMN 神经元或选择性阻断 OX2R→TMN 投射；全身基因缺失还可能伴随发育代偿。
findings.correctionEn: In Hdc-deficient mice, photostimulation of orexin neurons still shortened sleep-to-wake latency, showing that histamine synthesis was not required for rapid awakening under these experimental conditions. The experiment did not ablate TMN neurons or selectively interrupt the OX2R→TMN projection; constitutive gene deletion may also permit developmental compensation.
findings.verification: Freshly checked Carter 2009 original abstract and full-text HDC-knockout Results/Discussion. HDC deletion eliminates histamine synthesis; the intervention was not TMN-neuron ablation or projection-selective silencing. The paper itself discusses developmental compensation. Yamanaka 2002 supports the excitatory TMN connection independently.

findings.problem: “对 MT₂ 选择性较高的拮抗剂”笼统涵盖了选择性不同的两种工具化合物，也没有区分 PKC 实验的 CT10 条件与相移实验的两个时窗。不是对 MT₂ 参与方向的否定。

statement.zh: 对 MT₂ 选择性较高的拮抗剂阻断了褪黑素诱导的 SCN PKC 活化。
statement.en: Antagonists preferential for MT₂ blocked melatonin-induced PKC activation in the SCN.

scope.zh: Long-Evans 大鼠 SCN 切片 / 药理与 PKC 测定
scope.en: Long-Evans rat SCN slices / pharmacology and PKC assay

findings.correctionZh: MT₁/MT₂ 拮抗剂 luzindole 与 MT₂ 选择性拮抗剂 4P-PDOT 均阻断了褪黑素诱导的 SCN PKC 活性升高；亚型判定主要依赖拮抗剂药理学。
findings.correctionEn: The MT₁/MT₂ antagonist luzindole and the MT₂-selective antagonist 4P-PDOT each blocked melatonin-induced increases in SCN PKC activity; subtype attribution rests primarily on antagonist pharmacology.
findings.verification: Original Hunt 2001 abstract and publisher-indexed Results/Figure 6 freshly checked: PKC assay at CT10, 3 pM melatonin, 1 μM luzindole or 4P-PDOT. Avoid describing this as MT2 genetic necessity or asserting exclusive subtype selectivity at all concentrations.

findings.problem: Hnmt 缺失的光暗期睡眠–觉醒分布连到“皮层活化与觉醒”，容易把不同研究的终点合并。Naganuma 的分布表型不是 Zant 基底前脑实验中同一皮层活化指标；现有 context 符号和文字限制已经降低了风险，故列为图示改进而非现有正文事实错误。
findings.correctionZh: 保留基底前脑研究的“皮层活化与觉醒”节点，将 HNMT 表型连接到独立的“睡眠–觉醒昼夜分布”节点。
findings.correctionEn: Keep the basal-forebrain endpoint “Cortical activation & wake”, and connect the HNMT phenotype to a separate “Daily sleep–wake distribution” node.
findings.verification: Naganuma full text and EEG/EMG Results freshly checked: constitutive Hnmt deletion changed light/dark distribution; waking EEG showed a 3–5.5 Hz increase, not the same endpoint as Zant histamine-driven cortical activation. The existing context edge correctly avoids assigning a normal metabolic activation/inhibition sign.

findings.problem: 在体行为与离体 SCN 的浓度、暴露条件不同；现有简短 scope 容易被理解为同一暴露下的直接比较。

current.zh: 小鼠在体活动与离体 SCN / CT10 给药
current.en: Mouse behavior and SCN slices / CT10 dosing

findings.correctionZh: C57BL/6 小鼠：在体 CT10 皮下注射褪黑素 90 μg/只；另以离体 SCN 的 3–10 pM 褪黑素检验放电节律相移
findings.correctionEn: C57BL/6 mice: 90 μg melatonin per mouse, subcutaneous at CT10 in vivo; separately, 3–10 pM melatonin in isolated SCN preparations to test firing-rhythm phase shifts
findings.verification: Fresh primary abstract: behavioral phase advance after CT10 90 μg/mouse subcutaneous melatonin was absent in MT1 knockout, while SCN phase responses to 3 and 10 pM melatonin persisted. Existing context sign and warning against universal MT1-sleep/MT2-phase roles are appropriate.

findings.problem: 当前 H₃ 自受体分支正确，但图形没有一个具体异受体实例；不能将“未画出”理解为 H₃ 只在组胺末梢发挥作用。
findings.current: H3 graph has a histamine-release autoreceptor branch; hist-hrh3 limitation correctly states that receptor expression is not restricted to histamine neurons.
findings.correctionZh: 可补充一条限定于大鼠皮层的 H₃→5-HT 释放抑制关系，作为异受体实例；不新增其与睡眠状态的因果箭头。
findings.correctionEn: Optionally add one rat-cortical H₃→5-HT-release inhibitory relationship as a heteroreceptor example, without adding a causal arrow to sleep state.
findings.verification: Fresh original PubMed abstracts checked. The 1988 slice study used 3 Hz stimulation and antagonist pharmacology; the 1990 follow-up included synaptosomes and additional H3 agonist/antagonist controls, strengthening presynaptic interpretation. Neither study measured sleep behavior.

findings.problem: The existing blockade description omits simultaneous and bilateral conditions and can be read as preventing awakening itself. The primary endpoint was the stimulation-induced shortening of NREM-to-wake latency.

current.zh: 抑制 LC 或局部阻断食欲素信号，可阻断 Hcrt 神经元刺激诱发的 NREM 到觉醒转换。
current.en: LC inhibition or local orexin blockade prevented Hcrt stimulation-induced NREM-to-wake transitions.

findings.correctionZh: 限定为同步双侧 LC 光抑制，或 LC 区域双侧 SB-334867 注射，消除 Hcrt 光刺激缩短 NREM–觉醒潜伏期的效应。
findings.correctionEn: Specify concurrent bilateral LC inhibition and loss of the latency-shortening effect.

verification.method: Fresh online inspection of primary article or its original PubMed abstract; not inherited verification.
verification.locator: Results, Figures 2B–C and 3; concurrent bilateral inhibition effective, unilateral or subsequent inhibition ineffective.

findings.problem: The NAc projection result is state and stimulation-paradigm specific. A general initiation label omits the negative acute REM result and conflates acute transitions with repeated-stimulation wake maintenance.

current.zh: 刺激小鼠 VTA Th⁺ 神经元在 NAc 的投射可诱发并维持觉醒。
current.en: Stimulating projections of mouse VTA Th⁺ neurons in NAc initiated and maintained wakefulness.

findings.correctionZh: 急性 VTA→NAc 刺激的转换结果限定为 NREM；重复刺激增加觉醒另述，并注明急性 REM 实验阴性。
findings.correctionEn: Separate NREM-to-wake initiation from repeated-stimulation wake maintenance and retain the negative acute REM result.

verification.method: Fresh online inspection of primary article or its original PubMed abstract; not inherited verification.

findings.problem: The grouped structural edge hides a material construct difference: D4 used an engineered Gi/Gs chimera, whereas D2/D3 used dominant-negative Gi. This matters if the group is used to infer native coupling or compare interfaces.

current.zh: 结构显示受体–G 蛋白结合状态，不直接测量 G 蛋白活化、耦联效率或下游第二信使变化。
current.en: The structures show receptor–G protein binding states, not direct measurements of G protein activation, coupling efficiency or downstream second-messenger changes.

findings.correctionZh: 保留结构边，明确 D4 使用 G_i/G_s 嵌合 Gα；不能将复合物解析条件等同于天然 G_i 功能测量。
findings.correctionEn: Keep structural evidence, but disclose the D4 Gi/Gs chimera and separate it from native functional coupling.

findings.correctionEn: Classify RLS symptom improvement as a clinical outcome with neutral styling.

findings.problem: Name the actual DAT inhibitor so a compound-specific Drd2 knockout experiment is not mistaken for validation of every DAT inhibitor or of modafinil itself.

current.zh: Drd2 敲除削弱 DAT 抑制剂诱发的觉醒增加，支持 D₂ 受体参与该药理学反应。
current.en: Drd2 deletion attenuated DAT-inhibitor-induced increases in wakefulness, supporting D₂ receptor involvement in this pharmacological response.

findings.correctionZh: 将干预药物明确为 GBR12909；不将此边用于替代莫达非尼的独立证据。
findings.correctionEn: Name GBR12909; do not substitute this experiment for modafinil-specific evidence.

findings.problem: The existing millimolar potency and clinical limitation are correct. Adding the efficacy comparator makes partial agonism explicit and avoids confusing potency with efficacy.

current.zh: 在共表达 GABA_B1/GABA_B2 和 Kir3 的卵母细胞实验中，GHB 表现为低效价部分激动剂，EC₅₀ 约为 5 mM。
current.en: In oocytes coexpressing GABA_B1/GABA_B2 and Kir3, GHB behaved as a low-potency partial agonist, with an EC₅₀ of approximately 5 mM.

findings.correctionZh: 可补充该体系的最大效应约为 L-巴氯芬的 69%；仍仅为重组卵母细胞实验。
findings.correctionEn: Optionally give the assay maximum: 69% of L-baclofen.

current.en: Orexin-neuron-specific conditional Gabbr1 knockout fragmented sleep and wake without abnormal total sleep time or observed cataplexy.

findings.correctionZh: 改为与对照相比 24 小时累计各状态时间相近；“猝倒”使用动物实验的猝倒样行为表述。
findings.correctionEn: Describe comparable accumulated state times and absence of observed cataplexy-like events.
